app_icon.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: actual production application icon artwork for PiliAurora, a square full-bleed icon master.
Input image 1 is the exact character identity reference supplied by the user.
Primary request: turn this full-length anime portrait into a beautiful polished app icon illustration. Preserve the same recognizable silver-white long hair, lavender ribbon on viewer's right, tiny blue diamond forehead ornament, clear blue-violet eyes, soft pale face, and white/lavender collar bow. Make a centered head-and-shoulders close-up with a slightly simplified, crisp anime illustration style suitable for small app icons. The face, eyes, hair silhouette and bow should read clearly at 48 pixels. Reduce tiny dangling jewelry and intricate lace into clean graceful shapes while keeping the character identity. Gentle friendly smile, frontal pose.
Composition: square 1:1 canvas, whole head with a little breathing room above hair, head occupies about 65 percent of the canvas height, face near center, shoulders and collar bow visible in lower third. Keep face and distinguishing hair ornament inside the central 66 percent so Android circle/squircle masks do not cut them off. Long outer hair may reach the lower corners. No full body.
Style: premium anime character app icon, confident clean contours, refined soft cel shading, restrained highlights, slightly stronger outline contrast than the reference. Cute and elegant, not super deformed, not realistic or 3D. Palette: luminous ivory silver hair, periwinkle lavender accessories, clear blue irises, calm muted slate-periwinkle background with a very subtle radial light behind the head to distinguish white hair. The background is opaque and fills every corner. Avoid white-on-white low contrast.
Constraints: no text, letters, app names, logos, play buttons or other symbols, no border, no badge, no phone mockup, no rounded-corner clipping baked into image, no sparkles or noisy decorations, no watermark. Deliver only the square artwork.

coin:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: standalone production transparent video-app appreciation coin, used in a one/two coin selector.
Input images: image 1 is a style and material reference only. Reproduce the brass coin held by the character, without the character.
Primary request: exactly ONE warm brass token with a raised, clearly legible right-pointing play triangle embossed in its center. The coin must match the reference character's coin: honey gold face, darker copper-gold milled rim, softly beveled play triangle and a thin concentric inset ring.
Composition: close-up of complete circular coin, nearly front facing with a subtle three-quarter tilt showing a little thickness on right edge. Centered, 8 percent transparent margin on all sides. Clean true alpha background.
Style/medium: beautiful crisp 2D hand-painted anime game UI item, refined soft metal shading, restrained highlight on top-left, thin dark warm outlines, not photographic, not ultra-shiny 3D chrome, moderate detail readable at 35px.
Constraints: no hands, no person, no multiple coins, no words, letters, numbers or currency symbol, no sparkle, no shadow outside token, no floor, no watermark, no rectangular background.
coin_box:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production transparent coin receptacle sprite, 306x306 target, for a video app appreciation UI.
Input images: image 1 is the character palette/style reference, image 2 is the coin metal reference. Do not reproduce the person or loose coin.
Primary request: one small delightful coin-collection box, a little like a compact vintage film-projector body used as a tip jar. Rounded slate-blue enamel box with a warm ivory top plate, one wide dark coin slot visible at top, four tiny brass corner screws and a small embossed brass right-pointing play triangle on front. A narrow ivory inset window below the triangle with no lettering. A tiny rounded foot at each bottom corner.
Style: polished 2D anime game inventory item, fine dark slate outlines and crisp soft cel shading matching the chibi person, slight three-quarter perspective showing front, top and right side. Modest level of detail and warm tactile character. Not photorealistic, not a shiny toy.
Composition: exactly one complete box, centered, square canvas, 10 percent transparent padding on all sides. True transparent background. Box top and coin slot clearly visible. No loose coins, no ground plane, no external shadow.
Palette: muted slate blue #647C9F, warm ivory #EDE4D7, warm brass #CBA96F, dark slate #3F526B. No green and no neon.
Constraints: no character, no hands, no arms, no face, no wheels, no large projector lens, no words, letters or numbers, no watermark, no frame, no interface.
